title: English Practice Quiz 0583
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: Because I was tired, I went to bed early.
Because I tired, went bed early.
I because was tired bed early.
Because tired I went early bed.
questions.explanation: The subordinate clause beginning with because explains the reason.

questions.question: Read: 'Mina takes the bus at 8 a.m. and reaches work at 8:45.' How does Mina travel?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly says Mina takes the bus.

questions.question: Which question asks for a reason?
If I had more time, I ___ another language.
questions.explanation: The second conditional uses would + base verb for an unreal or imagined situation.

questions.question: They said, 'We have finished.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect commonly shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

questions.question: She is good at ___.
questions.explanation: A preposition such as at is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: Listen! The baby ___.
questions.explanation: Listen! suggests an action happening now, so use the present continuous.

questions.question: If a task is 'urgent', it needs ___.
questions.explanation: Urgent means requiring immediate or prompt attention.
